$comment: The documented production environment set: every variable the production
bundle (dist/vercel-api.cjs) must have in order to finish module load.
This is the input to scripts/ci/boot-probe.mjs. It is NOT a list of every
variable the app reads at runtime — only those without which the process
cannot boot at all. Variables a feature needs once serving belong in
The probe holds this list to two properties, so it cannot rot quietly:
sufficiency — the bundle boots with ONLY these set. A PR that makes the
app require a new variable fails until the variable is
added here, which is the review moment where somebody has
to also set it in Vercel.
necessity   — removing any one of these breaks the boot. Nobody can pad
the list to get CI green without the padding being caught.
Values are deliberately fake. The probe only proves the process starts; it
never connects to anything. Do not put a real secret in this file.
WHAT THIS CANNOT DO: it cannot verify Vercel actually has these set. See
